```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(htmltools)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Define the news updates
news_updates <- list(
  list(
    date = "2026-07-15",
    title = "Version 1.1.1 Released",
    details = c(
      "Projection branch release",
      "Custom proj.opts",
      "EM Ecov projections",
      "F-XSPR/F-MSY controls",
      "Hockey-stick HCR",
      "Saved hcr.config"
    )
  ),
  list(
    date = "2025-07-07",
    title = "Version 1.1.0 Released",
    details = c(
      "New performance figures",
      "Implementation error",
      "Environmental covariates",
      "Catchability random effects",
      "Catch apportionment options",
      "Metapopulation beta workflow",
      "Ontogenetic movement",
      "Movement Shiny app",
      "Movement configuration options",
      "HCR options",

    details = c(
      "Initial whamMSE release",
      "Core MSE workflow",
      "WHAM-based simulation checks"
    )
  )
)

# Create dropdown menu
dropdown_menu <- function(news) {
  tags$div(
    class = "dropdown",
    tags$button(class = "btn btn-primary dropdown-toggle", type = "button", id = "dropdownMenuButton", `data-toggle` = "dropdown", `aria-haspopup` = "true", `aria-expanded` = "false", "Recent News"),
    tags$div(class = "dropdown-menu", `aria-labelledby` = "dropdownMenuButton", 
      lapply(news, function(item) {
        tags$a(class = "dropdown-item", href = "#", item$title)
      })
    )
  )
}

# Render the dropdown menu
dropdown_menu(news_updates)
```

## Detailed Updates

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Display detailed news updates
for (item in news_updates) {
  cat(paste0("### ", item$title, "\n\n"))
  cat(paste0("**Date:** ", item$date, "\n\n"))
  if (!is.null(item$content) && nzchar(item$content)) {
    cat(paste0(item$content, "\n\n"))
  }
  if (!is.null(item$details)) {
    cat("<ul>\n")
    for (detail in item$details) {
      cat(paste0("<li>", htmlEscape(detail), "</li>\n"))
    }
    cat("</ul>\n\n")
  }
}
```
